author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
"Teachers may often interpret this as making sure students comprehend what they are reading. However, checking for comprehension by asking endless questions during reading can turn into an interrogation that interferes with the reading process.”

Such a good quote make sure reading instruction is always in the service of building knowledge. #edu407
